title: Grant-Done Handshake Overlap — Next Grant Pre-asserted
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [PROT] No idle cycle between consecutive grants; gnt never de-asserted
rtl:
always_ff @(posedge clk)
  if (done) gnt <= next_gnt;  // next_gnt already high — no gap
expected_root_cause: When the done signal fires, next_gnt is already asserted in the same cycle that the current grant is transferred; the downstream master sees no de-assertion gap between consecutive grants and interprets the continuous assertion as a single unbroken transaction.
fix_replacement:
always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  if (!rst_n)       gnt <= 4'h0;
  else if (done)    gnt <= 4'h0;      // Clear this cycle
  else if (!gnt_active) gnt <= next_gnt;  // Assert next cycle
description: When `done` fires, the logic simultaneously clears the current grant and asserts the next one in the same cycle; the receiving master sees a zero-cycle gap and misinterprets it as a continuous grant.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [PROT] No idle cycle between consecutive grants; gnt never de-asserted
success_log: One idle cycle observed between grants. Downstream correctly sees transaction boundary.
